name: AI Chatbot & Multi-Channel Social Chat
author: dragwyb

sections.description:
AI Chatbot & Multi-Channel Social Chat is a high-performance multi-channel chat and automated support WordPress plugin designed to bridge the gap between you and your visitors. Instead of a single-link tool, this plugin provides an all-in-one floating chat widget that supports an intelligent AI chatbot alongside multiple messaging and social platforms in one unified, sleek interface.

The plugin features a stylish, expandable floating button that acts as a central communication hub. Whether you need a 24/7 AI chatbot to answer automated inquiries, a social messenger redirect, or a direct link to your professional profiles, this plugin handles various channels simultaneously with zero impact on site performance.

Live Demo

Explore live examples of AI Chatbot & Multi-Channel Social Chat in action:

🔗 Click to Chat Demo Page

👉 Check out our other plugin: Flipbox Addon for Elementor – Create stunning animated 3D flip boxes for your WordPress site.

👉 Check out our other plugin: Smart Form Builder – The easiest & most powerful drag and drop form builder plugin for WordPress.

Why Use a AI Chatbot & Multi-Channel Social Chat Plugin?

  • Deploy an AI chatbot to offer instant, 24/7 automated customer support
  • Add a floating WhatsApp or Messenger chat button to WordPress
  • Allow visitors to contact you instantly from any page via their preferred app
  • Offer multiple communication options in a single chat widget
  • Improve lead generation and customer support accessibility
  • Maintain fast page speed and privacy compliance

🤖 Smart AI Chatbot Integration (New!)

Take your customer support to the next level. The newly integrated AI Chatbot allows you to answer common visitor queries automatically, reducing response times and capturing leads even when you are offline. Visitors can chat with the AI natively on your site or seamlessly switch to a social channel if they need human assistance.

🚀 All-in-One Multi-Channel Widget

This universal social chat widget allows you to offer your customers their preferred choice of communication, reducing friction and increasing lead generation. It is the perfect floating chat for WooCommerce, business portfolios, and service-based websites that need to capture inquiries across different channels.

💬 Versatile Social Redirect Features

Why limit your site to just one app? Our floating button supports a wide range of instant redirect options:
* Social Messaging: Direct links to the world’s most popular messaging and chat apps.
* Instant Redirects: Seamlessly transition users from your site to your social chat inboxes.
* Direct Voice & Text: Integrated “Click to Call” and SMS functionality for mobile users.
* Professional Networks: Quick-access links for business and networking platforms.

🛡️ Privacy & Performance First

Click to Chat is a privacy-first social chat widget. It is optimized for Core Web Vitals, ensuring your floating contact button and AI features never slow down your page speed.

👉 View Live Demo

Supported Communication Channels

  • AI Chatbot (Native) – Intelligent, automated on-site responses.
  • Social Messaging Apps – Connect via the most popular global chat platforms (WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, etc.).
  • Messenger Redirect – Instant links to your business chat inboxes.
  • Photo & Video Socials – Direct DMs for visual-heavy social networks.
  • Phone (Click to Call) – One-click dialing for immediate voice support.
  • Email & SMS – Traditional communication methods built into the widget.
  • Professional & Work Networks – Quick links to your corporate or creative profiles.

Key Features

  • Integrated AI Chatbot: Enable an automated AI assistant to greet visitors and answer questions 24/7.
  • Expandable Multi-Channel Widget: A clean, modern floating chat widget that holds multiple icons alongside your AI bot.
  • Channel Chat Widget: Includes an interactive channel chat widget complete with a customizable greeting message.
  • Custom Social Redirects: Easily configure where each button directs your visitors.
  • Smart Positioning: Choose bottom-left or bottom-right placement with custom pixel offsets.
  • Device Visibility Control: Display your social chat button and AI bot on mobile, desktop, or both.
  • Attention-Grabbing Delay: Set a timer for the floating button to appear after page load.
  • Custom Branding: Adjust colors, button sizes, and icon styles to match your theme.
  • Zero Dependencies: Pure, lightweight code with minimal impact on site performance.

Contribute

Dragwyb Click to Chat is an open-source project, and we welcome contributions from the community! Whether you want to fix a bug, improve the AI Chatbot integration, or add new social channels, your help is appreciated.

  • GitHub Repository: https://github.com/dragwyb/dragwyb-click-to-chat
  • Report Bugs: Please report any issues or bugs on the GitHub Issues page.
  • Pull Requests: Feel free to fork the repository and submit pull requests for review.

Recommended Plugins

If you find Click to Chat useful, check out our other top-rated plugin:

  • 🔄 Flipbox Addon for Elementor – The easiest way to design modern, animated flip boxes and 3D cards directly inside Elementor.
  • 🧩 Smart Form Builder – The easiest & most powerful drag and drop form builder plugin for WordPress.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dragwyb-click-to-chat directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open Click to Chat from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enable your AI Chatbot, configure your preferred social chat channels, and customize the widget.
sections.faq:
What is the AI Chatbot feature?

The newly added AI Chatbot is an automated assistant that lives inside your chat widget. It can greet visitors and instantly answer common queries natively on your website without requiring the user to switch apps.

Can I use both the AI Chatbot and the social media buttons?

Yes! The widget is designed to be an all-in-one hub. You can feature the AI Chatbot as the primary support method while keeping social redirect buttons (like WhatsApp or Messenger) available in the expandable menu.

What is a click to chat widget?

A click to chat widget is a floating button that lets website visitors instantly contact you via various social messaging apps, email, or phone.

Does this plugin support multiple chat platforms?

Yes. Dragwyb Click to Chat is a multi-channel tool that allows you to add several different social and contact redirect buttons in one widget.

Does this plugin store or track user data?

No. The social redirect functionality does not store cookies or collect analytics. The AI chatbot processes queries strictly to generate responses, maintaining user privacy.

Is this plugin suitable for business websites and eCommerce?

Yes. It is ideal for businesses, online stores, agencies, freelancers, and service providers looking for an omnichannel contact and automated support solution.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight, optimized for performance, and loads minimal assets to ensure fast page speeds.

  • Performance: Optimized asset loading for the new chatbot interface.

  • Fixed WhatsApp chat redirect issue.

  • Added channel chat widget and greeting message support.

  • SEO optimization for multi-channel social chat and floating button keywords.
  • Improved UI for the floating contact button menu.

1.0.2

  • Official public release with universal social redirect support.
  • Added support for professional networking and SMS channels.

1.0.1

  • Refactored code for better asset loading and performance.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
